facts.business: Sterling Tools Limited is a Tier-1 supplier of high-tensile cold forged fasteners to the automotive industry and, through its wholly owned subsidiary Sterling E-Mobility Solutions Limited, manufactures Motor Control Units (MCUs) and HVDC contactors for electric vehicles.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement due to volume discounts and variable consideration
Foreign currency risk on imports of raw materials, capital goods and export of finished goods
EV adoption pace has moderated though long-term opportunity remains compelling
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantee provided by Holding Company (Sterling Tools Limited) for term loan of Subsidiary Company (Sterling E-Mobility Solutions Limited); Freehold land held in name of Haryana Ispat Private Limited (related party).
